motion.name: pen-draw

motion.name: intro-write
motion.purpose: Greeting and name written in pen order, synced to scribble sound.

motion.name: intro-settle
motion.purpose: Greeting at up to 3.4x scale settles into the name slot.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: y 26px, 0.85s expo.out, stagger 85ms; avatar scale 0.6 to 1 back.out(1.8)
motion.purpose: Hero content rises in reading order.

motion.name: erase-rewrite
motion.value: erase 0.8s reverse stroke order, then write 2.4s
motion.purpose: Two seconds after settle the greeting un-writes and the full name is written.

motion.name: card-unclip
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0 round 14px) to 0, 1.1s expo.out, cards staggered 120ms
motion.purpose: Card media reveal, text rises 16px behind it.

motion.name: award-slide
motion.value: x -36px, 0.9s expo.out, stagger 0.1s; trophy scale 0 rotate -40 back.out(2.2)
motion.purpose: Award rows enter from the left.

motion.name: arrival-pop
motion.value: scale 1.07 yoyo 0.18s; marker 0.6s sweep, hold ~1.3s, 0.9s fade
motion.purpose: Section you jumped to answers; Lenis scroll 1.3s.

motion.name: light-trail
motion.value: 520ms life; light: cycling hue, multiply; dark: gold, screen
motion.purpose: Cursor ribbon on fine pointers only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transitions/animations 0.01ms; no intro, Lenis, reveals, pop, trail
motion.purpose: Name and sign-off shown fully drawn.

narrative.overview:
A clean white sheet that someone has gone over by hand. The ground is pure paper (#fff light, #000 dark) with near-black neutral ink in one grotesk, and three handmade marks sit on top of it. The name and the sign-off are written in a single-stroke script. Five highlighter colors are swiped behind key words. One pen color underlines titles and circles dates. Everything typeset stays quiet and neutral so the hand marks carry the personality.

The layout is a single centered column read from top to bottom: identity, Work, Projects, Awards, then the sign-off. Density is relaxed. The sections are separated by generous top padding and hairline rules, not by panels or background bands. Depth comes from soft ambient shadows on media cards and nowhere else.

Motion follows one rule: things are written, drawn, or rise into place, in reading order. The intro writes a greeting large, the greeting settles into the name slot, the content rises, the greeting is erased, and the full name is written in its place. Each section then reveals in its own way as it scrolls in. The page avoids the dark-hero-with-gradient developer template.
keyCharacteristics: Pure paper grounds: #fff light, #000 dark. No tint, no gradient.
Neutral achromatic ink ramp in three steps. Color lives only in the hand marks, the status/award accents, and the work tiles.
Script is reserved for the signature: the name, the "Thanks!" sign-off, and the avatar monogram placeholder.
The name and sign-off turn gold in dark mode. The pen changes from orange to gold.
Hand marks are drawn on, never just shown: markers sweep in left to right, pen strokes draw along their paths, and the script is written stroke by stroke.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The ground is pure #fff or pure #000. No off-white, no tinted dark, and no section background bands.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one pen color per theme (orange in light, gold in dark), and it is used only for title underlines and date loops.

rules.name: The Marker Pairing Rule
rules.body: Each marker has a light value and a dark value. Never reuse a light marker value under white dark-mode text.

rules.name: The Signature-Only Script Rule
rules.body: Satisfy is used only for the name, the sign-off, and the avatar monogram placeholder. Never use it for headings, labels, or decoration.

rules.name: The Lowercase Date Rule
rules.body: Dates are short and lowercase with an apostrophe year ("spring '26"). They are circled by the pen and never shown as a numeric range in the visible text.

rules.name: The Media-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only images, tiles, the avatar, and floating controls get a shadow. Work tiles are the exception: they are flat color blocks with no shadow.

dos: **Do** keep grounds at pure #fff / #000 and let color enter only through markers, pen, status, trophy, and tiles.
**Do** write the signature: render Satisfy as Vara strokes animated in pen order, with the plain text kept for screen readers.
**Do** pick markers from the five-color set. Use the light value behind ink and the dark value behind white text.
**Do** use one pen per theme (orange / gold) for title underlines and date loops only.
**Do** write dates short and lowercase ("feb '26", "since jul '25"), circled by the pen.
**Do** set tech stacks as plain " · "-separated ink-3 text.
**Do** label authored covers "illustration" wherever a real screenshot is missing.
**Do** give every motion a reduced-motion end state that shows the content in full.
donts: **Don't** use Satisfy for headings, labels, or ornament.
**Don't** render tech stacks as chips or pills. The pill is reserved for status.
**Don't** add a second pen color or use the pen for fills, icons, or text.
**Don't** tint the ground, add gradient heroes, or band sections with background color.
**Don't** put shadows on text, rows, or work tiles.
**Don't** block content behind the intro: it must be skippable and shown once per session.
